title: refactor(plugin-auth): move AuthManager's sign-in lockout path into auth-manager-sign-in-lockout.ts (#25224 cut 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMjbPDrsigsyqoKsV4WZQMz)_

Part of #25224
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

The basis for the `Clause-②: no` line: this is a move. No accept set, export, route, refusal or answer changes. The `.d.ts` bar is ruling `6348891160` item 1 (on #25222, covering this card): `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s published `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` are raw byte-identical to base (0 diff lines, so the union-order normalisation has nothing to do), with the ruling's positive control, and its entry exports the same 155 names under ESM and CJS (measured below).

Cut 2 of the `auth-manager.ts` split: **the sign-in lockout path (ADR-0069 D2) and the last-login stamp (D7).** Seven `AuthManager` method bodies, 173 lines, move unedited (re-indented one level) into one new module, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-sign-in-lockout.ts`. #25224 stays open for the later cuts.

This follows the card's claim `6351729156` (amending `6349004758` for cut 2, on the file cut 1 left: PR #25273, landed note `6351216603`). The shape is cut 1's, which is #23050's (landed note `6136102437`).

Branch: `claude/project-thread-lg3wrj`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `origin/main` after #25273 merged. It names no issue, so the card relation is this body's first line.

`auth-manager.ts` goes from 10,004 to 9,897 lines. The cut is +340 / −181 over 5 files (521 changed lines, under the 3,000-line line; two of the files are the regenerated tenant-audit census). Not a governed surface (`check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: 0 of the 5 paths hit the register).

## Why this seam

The first reading took the whole ADR-0069 enforcement tail (16 methods, base `:8852`–`:9951`: password policy, lockout, session controls). Five of those methods (`assertPasswordNotReused`, `recordPasswordHistory`, `unlockUser`, `enforceSessionControls`, `enforceConcurrentCap`) hold 6 of the file's 12 query-options `any`-erasure sites (measured with ESLint itself: the file linted at a path the baseline does not list reports exactly 12, the baseline's count). `scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json` grandfathers erasures per file and only ever loses keys, and the `query-options/no-any-erasure` rule blocks every file it does not list, so a move cannot carry a site into a new file without `pnpm lint` and the ratchet going red. Those five stay in `auth-manager.ts`. The fork was ruled on the card (`6351993113`, letter A, acknowledged in `6352024441`): after this cut merges, a separate sweep PR drops the file's 12 counted assertions in place (all 12, in nine methods; this paragraph's six are the ones the first reading reached) and ratchets the baseline down, and the nine methods move after it. This cut is the sign-in path's coherent remainder, and its bodies hold none (the new module lints with 0 sites; `auth-manager.ts` keeps its 12, so the baseline holds untouched).

## What moved

| method | base body | lines | members it reads |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `assertAccountNotLocked` | `:9438`–`:9472` | 35 | `config`, `findSignInAccount`, `getDataEngine` |
| `recordSignInOutcome` | `:9497`–`:9542` | 46 | `config`, `findSignInAccount`, `getDataEngine`, `logDurabilityDegradation` |
| `auditRefusedSignIn` | `:9561`–`:9586` | 26 | `config`, `resolveSignInAccountId` |
| `resolveSignInAccountId` | `:9594`–`:9611` | 18 | `findSignInAccount`, `getDataEngine`, `logDurabilityDegradation` |
| `findSignInAccount` | `:9641`–`:9651` | 11 | none |
| `resolveTwoFactorAccountLockout` | `:9682`–`:9691` | 10 | `config` |
| `stampLastLogin` | `:9721`–`:9747` | 27 | `getDataEngine`, `logDurabilityDegradation` |

Lines are base `49185cdb8a`. The members are a walk of every `this.X` in each body with the TypeScript compiler API: no bare `this`, no `this[...]`, no `arguments`, no `super`, no assignment to a `this` member.

No module-level declaration moves. The imports that only the moved bodies used left with them (`accountLockedEventFor`, `refusalCodeOf`, `signInClientFingerprint` and `signInFailureEventFor` from `auth-session-audit.js`, and the `EngineQueryOptions` type); the new module imports each from the module `auth-manager.ts` imported it from.

## The shape

- **The class keeps every method**, at its place, with its name, signature and docblock: the published `.d.ts` lists each one. Its body is now a host literal of exactly the members that body reads, typed as a `Pick` of `SignInLockoutHost`, plus `.call`. `findSignInAccount` reads no member and calls its function directly.
- **`SignInLockoutHost`** (in the new module) names the five members the bodies read, each typed as the class member (`AuthManager['getDataEngine']`, …). The new module imports `AuthManager` as a type only, so there is no runtime cycle.
- **Methods go as late-bound closures** (`(...a) => this.getDataEngine(...a)`), so a test double or spy set on the manager is still the one a body reaches. That includes `findSignInAccount` and `resolveSignInAccountId`, which bodies here ask through the manager.
- **`config` goes as a getter**: the class reassigns it after construction (`setBaseUrl`, `applyConfigPatch`), and the bodies read it after an `await`.
- **Six of the methods are no longer `async`.** Each returns the moved async function's own promise, so a caller awaits the same promise the body settles. Building the host cannot throw, so no method throws synchronously where it used to reject. `resolveTwoFactorAccountLockout` was synchronous and stays so.
- **Nothing re-exports the new module**, so the published surface does not move.

## Readers re-pointed in the same PR

| reader | what it read | base | head |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api-error-code.pin.test.ts` | the sum of `new APIError(` sites over the files `AuthManager`'s bodies live in (floor 24) | 18 + 9 = 27 | 17 + 9 + 1 = 27: the `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` throw of `assertAccountNotLocked` moved, so the module joins the list |
| the tenant-audit census (`check-tenant-audit-census.mjs`, its committed page and counts file) | every engine write call site, keyed by file | `auth-manager.ts` `update` `sys_user`: 8 | `auth-manager.ts`: 5, `auth-manager-sign-in-lockout.ts`: 3; regenerated with `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`, and the page's two hand-written erased-receiver counts follow (41 → 44); see below |

Without the pin edit the sum read 26 and the floor held in silence, which is the drift the card forbids. Measured as reading no moved line: the plugin-factory scans in `better-auth-schema-parity.test.ts` and `managed-extension-fields.test.ts` (the module imports no factory), `pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` (exit 0; no row names a stamp in a moved body), the query-options erasure ratchet (`62 unswept non-test site(s) in 16 file(s), none new`, key set verified against `49185cd`), the ADR-0093/0108 anchor of `auth-manager.ts` (names `settleMembership` and the roles map, neither moved), and no `docs/qa/platform-checklist` anchor or docs page names a moved method.

## The census reading

The census moves in one way a reviewer should see. It reads 236 engine write sites at base and at head, and every site keeps its object, tenancy, options and elevation reading (compared per site, with the new module's file name mapped back to `auth-manager.ts`). What changes is how it reaches three of them: the `engine.update('sys_user', ...)` calls of `recordSignInOutcome` (2, base `:9508` and `:9524`) and `stampLastLogin` (1, base `:9730`).

- In the class, their receiver is `const engine = this.getDataEngine()`. The census reads that through the method's declared return type in the same file (`getDataEngine(): IDataEngine | undefined`), so the three counted as "receiver carried a readable engine type".
- In the module, the same text runs on a `this` typed as `Pick<SignInLockoutHost, ...>`, and the census does not follow a function's `this` parameter. It places the three by their literal object name, `sys_user`, a declared object, so none of them is lost or excused by a ledger row, and the run reports 0 unresolved and 0 unledgered receivers at base and at head.
- The generated table moves `readable engine type` 195 → 192 and `placed by the object NAME` 31 → 34. The two hand-written counts the gate checks on the page (`PROSE_COUNTS`) are that sum, so they move 41 → 44. The corpus-scale block (not enforced) is re-measured too: 706 sources, 1 more than base for the new module.

Keeping the three typed would mean editing the moved bodies (an annotation on `engine`) or teaching the census to read `this` parameters. The first is not a move and the second is a census logic change, so neither belongs in this PR. Later cuts that move engine writes on this host shape will show the same effect.

## Proof

Builds and suites ran through `os-verify-lock`, every exit code captured before any pipe. Base `49185cdb8a`; head `75983184cc` (the move `c204bd096c`, the pin reader `4ee263903a`, the census `f898b1e719`, then a merge of `origin/main` at `5801a4f2c9`, whose five commits touch no `plugin-auth` file and auto-merged the census page's prose). Proofs 1 to 3 were taken at `4ee263903a`, whose `plugin-auth` source is the head's, and re-read at `75983184cc` after a full `turbo run build`: the suite gave the same counts and both `.d.ts` files the same raw hashes.

**1. The moved text.** For each of the seven methods, the base class body and the new module's function body are the same TypeScript token sequence (scanner tokens, kind and text, trivia skipped, each template literal re-scanned at its substitutions as the parser does), every line is the base line minus exactly two leading spaces, the parameters and return type are the same text, and the class method keeps its docblock and signature with `async` dropped: 7 of 7 pass, 173 body lines. An independent reading: `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change 49185cdb8a 4ee263903a` over the two files marks 163 of the 169 deleted lines and 177 of the 327 added lines as moved. The 6 other deleted lines are the six `private async …(` signature lines (their methods stay, without `async`); the 150 other added lines are the seven class methods' new signature lines and host literals, `SignInLockoutHost`, the module header, the per-function pointer docblocks and the new import.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports (ruling `6348891160` items 1 and 2).** Built through `turbo run build` at base and `pnpm run build` of the package at head:

| file | raw base | raw head | raw diff lines | normalised base | normalised head |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `dist/index.d.ts` | `462694a9be58c0ed9b0bc7541828e62911a2a2c874a27d5e6cea9740ae734d4b` | `462694a9be58c0ed9b0bc7541828e62911a2a2c874a27d5e6cea9740ae734d4b` | 0 | `05e3e4dc5f32e40f6d16b2f48a4e132b4315a9c98b9478941b0351154e0610df` | `05e3e4dc5f32e40f6d16b2f48a4e132b4315a9c98b9478941b0351154e0610df` |
| `dist/index.d.mts` | `ea7e59d064510a044cf630f63b2c9f4b5cd41dd22d32b326267abfd870272fdb` | `ea7e59d064510a044cf630f63b2c9f4b5cd41dd22d32b326267abfd870272fdb` | 0 | `80fc0552ec518819842bad5e3fab8cc24075c382a5693594a1428b9e73fd6e48` | `80fc0552ec518819842bad5e3fab8cc24075c382a5693594a1428b9e73fd6e48` |

- The normaliser, verbatim (the ruling's one-liner): `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum`.
- The raw files are already byte-identical, so no union-order swap occurs in this cut: items 1(b) and 1(d) hold with nothing to account for.
- **Positive control:** the head `dist/index.d.ts` with one private member made public (`private assertAccountNotLocked;` → `assertAccountNotLocked;`, line 4015, a one-line change) hashes raw `5e437fc5736b14b2261fbf4976a1e7c5d47d3fadd275566e4ce8af718aabdcee` and normalised `ec108851cd97419575810eec1cbc85dad9a983519eeb3ee90ef07d1646f52dd1`, both different from the readings above.
- **Export lists:** ESM `dist/index.mjs` 155 names and CJS `dist/index.js` 155 names at base and at head, the same list (sha256 of the sorted names `ed3ac8b902031d30…` on all four). The bundle's bytes differ (`index.mjs`), as a move of code inside it must.

**3. Tests.** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`, at head and at base in the same container: `Test Files 185 passed (185)`, `Tests 3493 passed | 10 skipped (3503)` on both, VERDICT command-exit 0 on both, and the same at `75983184cc`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (both `tsc` projects and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config` (the root `lint` script's flags) over the 3 files: exit 0.

**4. Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 89 commands for the 5 paths (59 for the three source paths, 30 more for the two census documents); all 89 ran at `f898b1e719` and again at `75983184cc` after the full build, each exit code captured before any pipe, all 89 exit 0 both times. `--ran`: 89 derived, 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. At `4ee263903a` (before the census commit) the derivation was 59 and the only two that exited 1 were `node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs` and its `--self-test` (the per-file drift and the two prose counts above); after `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` and the two prose edits both exit 0, and a further `--write` changes only the not-compared `Measured on … at` stamp. Measured at base and head: the census reads 236 sites with 0 unresolved and 0 unledgered receivers on both, and every site's object, tenancy, options and elevation reading is the same. `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 521 changed lines. Docs drift (`node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 49185cdb8a`, exit 0): 6 pages, each reached through the `AuthManager` class name, the `durationSeconds` name (a field of the class, not a moved line), or a literal the moved bodies carry unchanged (`ACCOUNT_LOCKED`, `locked_until`, `login_failed`, `last_login_ip`); no page restates a rule this move changes, so no page edit is owed beyond the census's own two documents.

## Changeset

None: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4. The published declarations and export lists are unchanged; the bundle's bytes move only because code moved inside it.
